rationale: Price is at 97.4% of today's range and within 0.11% of the session high, meaning the risk/reward for a long is poor (chasing the top with minimal upside to the high) and a short lacks confirmation of reversal — the last candle showed a strong volume surge to $13.63 with no rejection yet. The broad market is under pressure (SPY -0.88%, VIXY +2.32%), which adds macro headwind for a long, but without a clear short-side setup forming at this level, the prudent action is to wait for either a breakout with continuation or a rejection candle before committing capital.
